release: Dinovol training fixes and experimental FP32 attention, September2026

warm_start.native_entries_note: These24 matching initial/default entries do not show learned weights were loaded.

fp32_attention_paired96.gradient_sampling: 128 evenly spaced indices per parameter at most; post-unscale/post-clipping

fp32_attention_integrated128.native_status: out of memory at95% allocator fraction; no finite speedup claimed
fp32_attention_integrated128.masking: fixed25% on half of global views
fp32_attention_integrated128.initialization: official step352500 pretrained backbone, fresh seeded heads and AdamW; not a full-checkpoint resume

limitations: Short deterministic real-CT training experiment, not convergence or ink-reading validation.
FP32 attention is experimental and default-off; unsupported/already-fused cases retain native SDPA.
Numerical parity was measured at96 cubed. Native128 cubed failed, so same-size128 training parity is untested.
The faster FP16 training path was rejected after substantial sampled gradient/update differences; its evidence is retained.
Existing padding and PyTorch checkpointing techniques are prior art. Training fixes and validation are this contribution.
No upstream adoption or prize outcome is claimed.
